_doc: Seeded, shrink-only allowlist of test_kernel_backend_imports.py: today's backend SDK imports in src/sandloom/core outside core/drivers. A new (file, sdk) or a higher count fails; a stale entry does not. removed_by names the slice that removes the site, or why it stays. idk-ratchets-close prunes it and makes the test strict. The scan covers src/sandloom/core (outside core/drivers and unit tests), src/sandloom/sdk and src/sandloom/shared.
